lanes.name: core
lanes.description: VideoToolCore pure gesture logic (Swift Testing) built with plain swiftc; works inside the agent sandbox.

lanes.name: unit
lanes.description: App tests that need no media decoding or speech models (windows may still create an idle mpv). Run outside the sandbox. Exit 65 = test failure.
lanes.command: scripts/xcb.sh test -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/MPVIntegrationTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/FormatMatrixTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/AISubtitleIntegrationTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/SpeedAudioTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/AudioOutputEngineTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/PlayerWiringTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/AIJobLifecycleTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/AppleSpeechErrorTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/QualityTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/StressTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipExporterTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipSubtitleTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipExportPlayerTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipSubtitlePlayerTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/NightModeTests -skip-testing:VideoToolTests/SkipPlayerTests; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 65 ]; then exit 1; fi; exit $rc

lanes.name: integration
lanes.description: Real libmpv playback, every bundled format, AI subtitles with the on-device recogniser, sound output and audio at speed, clip/GIF export with burned-in subtitles, night mode, intro/outro skipping. QualityTests/StressTests stay opt-in (tools/quality_check.sh, tools/stress_library.sh).
lanes.command: scripts/xcb.sh test -only-testing:VideoToolTests/MPVIntegrationTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/FormatMatrixTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/AISubtitleIntegrationTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/SpeedAudioTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/AudioOutputEngineTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/PlayerWiringTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/AIJobLifecycleTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/AppleSpeechErrorTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipExporterTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipSubtitleTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipExportPlayerTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/ClipSubtitlePlayerTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/NightModeTests -only-testing:VideoToolTests/SkipPlayerTests; rc=$?; if [ $rc -eq 65 ]; then exit 1; fi; exit $rc
